description: This file defines the 'ForNode' class, which represents a 'for' loop construct in Twig templates. It includes methods for constructing the node and for generating the PHP code that executes the loop, handling loop context variables, and optional 'else' clauses.

classes.name: ForNode
classes.description: Represents a 'for' loop node in Twig's abstract syntax tree, with code generation capabilities for rendering the loop in PHP.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a ForNode with variables for key and value targets, the sequence to iterate, optional 'if' expression, loop body, optional 'else' node, and line number.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code to execute the 'for' loop, managing context variables, loop metadata, and handling optional 'else' clause.
